scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — colorblind-safe Tol palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and a thoughtful annotation stack (percentile dashed lines, leader callouts, marginal box plot) elevate this well above generic, but the top-earner callout labels cluster awkwardly on the right edge with 'Sam Q.' clipped, and P25/subtitle text collides at the top.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is the correct choice for right-skewed income data, box plot statistics and percentile lines are data-driven, no baseline or area-encoding violations, but the x-scale domain is hardcoded ([14000, 550000]) instead of derived from d3.extent, failing the scaling and shift metamorphic relations.
scores.stress_test_note: Mostly static visualization with force simulation pre-computed synchronously; the only interaction is a pointer-events tooltip with trivial CSS-only updates on pointermove, so all five stress-test criteria pass cleanly.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single view, 4-category colorblind-safe palette, pre-computed swarm with no animation, and a supporting box plot keep load low; the 5 top-earner callout lines cluster and slightly overlap in the upper-right corner but remain legible.
